messages:
Alex G: Heads up — metering alerts just tripped. dashboards show token_count (emitter-agg) drifting +~25% vs the last 3 hours for hosted API. started around 02:12Z. incident bot created a SEV-2 ticket. anyone oncall?

Incident Bot: SEV-2 — metering-aggregator-drift created by alerting-service at 2026-03-10T02:18:04Z. Paging ops-oncall.

Maria L: oncall here, pulling graphs. is this across all regions or just us-east-1?

Alex G: mainly us-east-1 and eu-west-1. ap-south looks normal.

Priya K: I'm seeing the emitter shard lagging on commit timeouts, lots of replays. may be double-counting when emitter retries.

Sam R: opening metering logs now. grep shows repeated ack attempts from emitter-worker-7. snippet: ```
[2026-03-10T02:13:29Z] emitter-worker-7 RETRY publish token_batch id=abcd1234 attempt=2 status=timeout
[2026-03-10T02:13:29Z] emitter-worker-7 RETRY publish token_batch id=abcd1234 attempt=3 status=success
```

Maria L: that pattern matches a previously fixed bug where a publish success event didn't dedupe on idempotency key. could this be a regression from yesterday's aggregator deploy?

Priya K: yes, we had an aggregator roll yesterday that touched the publish path. I can check the deploy diff.

Leah C: CS flags — we've started seeing automated overage notifications to a small set of customers. queued a hold request with billing to prevent charges while we investigate.

billing-robot: Billing hold placed for impacted accounts: count=18. hold_id=HOLD-20260310-71.

Alex G: good. mitigation priorities: 1) stop further overcounting 2) stop notifications/charges 3) reconcile historical drift 4) root cause + fix.

Sam R: quick mitigation option: switch emitter workers to fallback dedupe=True path that uses in-memory de-dup window (safer but slower). can flip via feature flag.

Maria L: roll the flag to 10% first. Priya, can you prepare the rollback if latency spikes?

Priya K: will create rollout in console. command: ```sh
redwoodctl feature-flag set emitter_dedupe_fallback=true --env prod --pct 10
```

Incident Bot: Feature flag rollout started by Priya K at 2026-03-10T02:27:12Z. Target: prod.

Alex G: also ngrep on the aggregator to confirm idempotency keys present in publish payloads. sample schema: `{"batch_id":"abcd1234","idempotency_key":"epk-9f2a","tokens":12345}`

Sam R: confirmed epk present in most publishes but a subset (~8%) had epk=null. correlates with emitter-worker-7 traces.

Leah C: CS update: we've also paused automated billing emails. contact list: billing-ops, cs-leads.

Maria L: flag at 10% rolled to 32% after 4m, latency impact negligible. rolling to 100% now.

Incident Bot: Feature flag rollout reached 100% at 2026-03-10T02:34:01Z.

Priya K: rollover completed. emitter-workers now set to dedupe fallback. I'm watching the metrics.

Sam R: token_count delta stabilizing. current drift down to +3% at 02:40Z.

Alex G: nice. Leah, confirm billing holds still in place for the 18 accounts and CS notified them?

Leah C: confirmed holds active. messaged customers with human note. some asked for ETA on resolution.

billing-robot: Billing hold still active: HOLD-20260310-71 state=active.

Priya K: for reconciliation: we'll generate a corrected emit report from raw events between 02:12Z-02:34Z, dedupe using epk, and produce delta file. I'll kick off a backfill job but it will take ~45m.

Maria L: good plan. Alex, we should set a post-incident follow-up: patch to ensure publish path enforces non-null epk and add unit test + e2e that simulates retries.

Alex G: agreed. postmortem owners: Priya (root cause + fix), Sam (reconciliation + backfill), Leah (customer communication + billing remediation).

Incident Bot: Incident SEV-2 metering-aggregator-drift marked mitigated at 2026-03-10T03:05:30Z by Maria L.

Alex G: thanks everyone. we'll keep the hold until reconciliation done and then push credits / billing adjustments as needed.

Leah C: will coordinate credits and confirm closure with customers.

Sam R: starting the backfill job now. logs show progress: `processed 10k batches/min`. ETA ~40m.

Priya K: opening PR with patch: enforce epk non-null and add dedupe test. link: https://git.redwood/infer/agg/commit/9f7b2

Maria L: excellent. schedule postmortem for tomorrow 10:00 PT.

Leah C: closing loop: customers ok with temporary holds and waiting for reconciliation. will follow up after backfill completes.

billing-robot: Backfill delta completed at 2026-03-10T03:45:12Z. delta_total_tokens=+0 (reconciled), impacted_accounts=18, adjustments_pending=true.

Alex G: wait, delta_total_tokens=+0? Sam, can you confirm.

Sam R: looks like after dedupe the extra counts were canceled by some late duplicate suppression downstream. I'll run a detailed diff and produce CSV.

Sam R: CSV link: s3://redwood-mitreports/2026-03-10/metering-delta-1766005555.csv

Alex G: perfect. Leah, when adjustments_pending=true, what next?

Leah C: billing will apply credit holds programmatically once we approve the CSV. I'll review and trigger refunds/credits for the 18 accounts.

Maria L: add follow-up action: improve alert to include suspected cause (epk-null fraction) and a runbook step to flip dedupe flag quickly.

Alex G: agreed. closing oncall. good incident handling.

Incident Bot: Incident channel archived at 2026-03-10T04:00:00Z.
